entries.name: Hash Crack: Password Cracking Manual (v3)
entries.description: Password Cracking Manual v3 is an expanded reference guide for password recovery (cracking) methods, tools, and analysis techniques.

entries.name: Cloud_crack
entries.description: Crack passwords using Terraform and AWS.

entries.name: Cloudcat
entries.description: A script to automate the creation of cloud infrastructure for hash cracking.

entries.name: Cloudstomp
entries.description: Automated deployment of instances on EC2 via plugin for high CPU/GPU applications at the lowest price.

entries.name: Cloudtopolis
entries.description: A tool that facilitates the installation and provisioning of Hashtopolis on the Google Cloud Shell platform, quickly and completely unattended (and also, free!).

entries.name: NPK
entries.description: NPK is a distributed hash-cracking platform built entirely of serverless components in AWS including Cognito, DynamoDB, and S3.

entries.name: Penglab
entries.description: Abuse of Google Colab for cracking hashes.

entries.name: 7z2hashcat
entries.description: Extract information from password-protected .7z archives (and .sfx files) such that you can crack these "hashes" with hashcat.

entries.description: Convert macOS plist password file to hash file for password crackers.

entries.name: Rubeus-to-Hashcat
entries.description: Converts / formats Rubeus kerberoasting output into hashcat readable format.

entries.name: WINHELLO2hashcat
entries.description: With this tool one can extract the "hash" from a WINDOWS HELLO PIN. This hash can be cracked with Hashcat.

entries.name: bitwarden2hashcat

entries.name: mongodb2hashcat
entries.description: Extract hashes from the MongoDB database server to a hash format that hashcat accepts: -m 24100 (SCRAM-SHA-1) or -m 24200 (SCRAM-SHA-256).

entries.description: Python C API binding to libhashcat.

entries.description: Hashcat wrapper to help automate the cracking process.

entries.description: Identify hashing algorithms (GUI frontend for Name That Hash).

entries.description: Don't know what type of hash it is? Name That Hash will name that hash type! Identify MD5, SHA256 and 300+ other hashes. Comes with a neat web app.

entries.description: Free hash lookup service supplying wordlists as well.

entries.description: Go CLI app to quickly lookup hashes using the HashMob API.

entries.name: bopscrk
entries.description: Generate smart and powerful wordlists for targeted attacks. Includes song lyrics fetching and different transforms.

entries.name: common-substr
entries.description: Simple tool to extract the most common substrings from an input text. Built for password cracking.

entries.name: Crunch
entries.description: Crunch is a wordlist generator where you can specify a standard character set or a character set you specify. Crunch can generate all possible combinations and permutations.

entries.description: A tool that lets you generate wordlists by user profiling data such as birthday, nickname, address, name of a pet or relative etc.

entries.description: Tool for generating wordlists or extending an existing one using mutations.

entries.description: Create n-grams of wordlists based on words, characters, or charsets to use in offline password attacks and data analysis.

entries.name: Elpscrk

entries.name: Keyboard-Walk-Generators

entries.name: kwprocessor
entries.description: Advanced keyboard-walk generator with configureable basechars, keymap and routes.

entries.name: maskprocessor
entries.description: High-performance word generator with a per-position configureable charset.

entries.name: maskuni
entries.description: A standalone fast word generator in the spirit of hashcat's mask generator with unicode support.

entries.name: Mentalist
entries.description: Mentalist is a graphical tool for custom wordlist generation. It utilizes common human paradigms for constructing passwords and can output the full wordlist as well as rules compatible with Hashcat and John the Ripper.

entries.name: PTT
entries.description: The Password Transformation Tool (ptt) is a versatile utility designed for password cracking. It facilitates the creation of custom rules and transformations, as well as the generation of wordlists. This tool supports processing data from files, URLs, and standard input, streamlining cracking workflows.

entries.name: Phraser
entries.description: Phraser is a phrase generator using n-grams and Markov chains to generate phrases for passphrase cracking.

entries.name: princeprocessor
entries.description: Standalone password candidate generator using the PRINCE algorithm.

entries.name: Rephraser
entries.description: A Python-based reimagining of Phraser using Markov-chains for linguistically-correct password cracking.

entries.name: Rling
entries.description: RLI Next Gen (Rling), a faster multi-threaded, feature rich alternative to rli found in hashcat utilities.

entries.name: statsprocessor
entries.description: Word generator based on per-position markov-chains.

entries.name: StringZilla
entries.description: Fastest string sort, search, split, and shuffle for long strings and multi-gigabyte files in Python and C.

entries.name: TTPassGen
entries.description: Flexible and scriptable password dictionary generator which supportss brute-force, combination, complex rule modes etc.

entries.name: token-reverser
entries.description: Words list generator to crack security tokens.

entries.name: WikiRaider
entries.description: WikiRaider enables you to generate wordlists based on country specific databases of Wikipedia.

entries.name: Albanian wordlist
entries.description: A mix of names, last names and some albanian literature.

entries.name: WeakPass
entries.description: Collection of large wordlists.

entries.description: Cracking passwords of private key entries in a JKS file.

entries.name: bkcrack

entries.name: frackzip
entries.description: Small tool for cracking encrypted ZIP archives.

entries.name: RNN-Passwords

entries.description: This tool finds efficient password mangling rules (for John the Ripper or Hashcat) for a given dictionary and a list of passwords.

entries.name: PassGPT
entries.description: PassGPT is a GPT-2 model trained from scratch on password leaks.

entries.description: A password guessing method that utilizes word embeddings to discover and exploit semantic correlations in password lists.
